​Movement & Local Player
​Infinite Stamina: Bypasses the stamina drain system and locks your WalkSpeed to a constant sprint.

​Green: Standard Survivor
​White: Medic Role
​Purple: Fighter Role
Blue: Security Guard

​Killer Detection: Bright red highlight on the Killer to maintain awareness at all times.

​Combat Enhancements
​Auto-Parry: Automatically triggers a block/swing when the Killer enters a 10-stud radius (Requires Fighter/Axe).

​📝 Patch Notes & Updates

​Update v1.0.4

​Optimization: Re-coded the Loading Screen for better performance on low-end mobile devices.

​Fixes

​Fixed: Resolved a crash issue when switching between "Bite By Night" and "Midnight" themes.

​Fixed: Corrected a bug where Noclip would occasionally reset after being downed.

​Fixed: Improved the IdentifyExecutor check to prevent script errors on budget executors.

​Fixed: Adjusted the Fly logic to prevent "Rubber-banding" on high-latency servers.

​⚙️ Technical Info

​UI Library: Obsidian UI UI
​Theme: Custom "Bite By Night" Fiery

scripts.title: Nuker
scripts.features: Basically an open source nuker, you need a good executer otherwise it wont work. Already had complaints. Breaks everything near you!
scripts.script:
-- should work on your executer if not then try to fix it yourself, I left it open source.
-- breaks any blocks within a 5 by 5 block radius
local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
local ws = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ps = game:GetService("Players")
local liberal = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Libs
local sys = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Systems
local m_Coord = require(liberal.Coordinates)
local m_Act = require(sys.ActionsSystem)
local m_State = require(liberal.BlockState)
local larp = ps.LocalPlayer
local map = ws:FindFirstChild("Map")
local rad, wait = 5, 0.001

local function nuker()
    local root = larp.Character and larp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not map then return end
    local p_list = ws:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, rad * 4)
    for i = 1, #p_list do
        local p = p_list[i]
        if not p or not p:IsDescendantOf(map) then continue end
        local attr = p:GetAttribute(m_State.ATTRIBUTE)
        if not attr then continue end
        local ok, pos = pcall(m_Coord.coordinatesFromWorkspaceVector3, p.Position)
        if not ok or not pos then continue end
        local r, ch, bn = m_Coord.regionNameFromCoordinates(pos), m_Coord.chunkNameFromCoordinates(pos), m_Coord.blockNameFromCoordinates(pos)
        if r and ch and bn then
            task.spawn(m_Act.client_breakBlock, r, ch, bn, m_State.getBlockId(attr) or 1)
            if i % 2 == 0 then task.wait(wait) end
        end
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        nuker()
        rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
end)
